<!-- pr-reviewer: 325187e62e6b40c03c8258f9133002405dae1871 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The code is correct and safe. One finding: the Adaptive argument of the PR body and the decision file is true only for the test fixture, and the real Adaptive spiral path round a part has no pin.

Review at the safety-floor level (2D toolpath links). I read the strategy resolution myself and did not start from the author's conclusions.

### What looks good
- **One predicate, read on the posted strategy.** `ring_links::rings` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/ring_links.rs:102`) gates `for_side` (`ring_links.rs:86`). In `pocket.rs` the `strategy` passed at line 353 is the one that `adaptive_passes_from` returns (line 311), so a fallback to Offset rings is read as `OffsetRings` and a real HSM plan as `Adaptive`. In `pocket_avoid.rs:256` it is `actual`, the strategy of each level. Both callers use the same rule.
- **The real Adaptive spiral is kept out of the ring law.** When the HSM plan succeeds, the strategy is `Adaptive`, `ring_links` is `None`, and `pass_link` takes the arms from before #3818 (`ladder_links.rs:162-189`). The `level_order` joins of #3818 are only in `level_rings::ring_plan`, and the HSM plan does not use it. I checked the other #3818 edits (`levels.rs`, `pocket_emit.rs`, `pocket_avoid_level.rs`): they only carry `ring_links`.
- **Clearance is honoured.** `(Some(Err(why)), Link::Clearance)` lifts to `m.clearance_z` and tallies with `CLEARANCE_PLANE` (`ladder_links.rs:179-182`). The rapid, the dead-end ramp and the re-entry below it read `plane`, as the old `(None, Link::Clearance)` arm does. KeepDown, Retract and the default keep `hop_z`. The default note text does not change (`links.rs`, `RETRACT_PLANE`).
- **2D Pocket with Outside containment, readings from this review:**
  - Disc, Waterline and Offset rings, Inside and Outside: 0 lifts, 0 re-entries.
  - Dog bone, the two strategies, Inside and Outside: 0 lifts, 0 re-entries. No overcut (shape mask), no crossing feeds.
  - Clamp, Outside, the two strategies: 26 lifts, 26 named. Clearance lifts all to 10.0. Retract and KeepDown lift all to 2.0. `avoid_hits` is empty.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in the changed source. The Zigzag digest pin fails if the predicate is removed.
- No overlap with #3823: `git merge-tree` of this head with the #3823 head was clean, and it is clean with the current `main` (`f519445d4`, which includes #3823). The open #3824 work changes `pass_link`. This PR changes the failed-link arm of the same function, so the #3824 worker must keep the Clearance arm when it adds the edge route. There is no logic conflict.

### Results (merged with main, locally)
Trial merge of `325187e62` with `origin/main` `a6cd476fd`: clean. `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6`, `-j 6`, sccache. No self-hosted runner was used.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test pass_start_levels` | 18 passed, 0 failed (with the 5 new pins) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test pocket_pass_start` (debug) | 5 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Main moved after the trial merge (#3823, #2969). The textual merge with `f519445d4` is clean. I did not build that tree.

### Heavy lanes
- The heavy dry run reaches `motion heavy: every target` and `app heavy: every target` (`links.rs` changed).
- By the coordinator's order, only the targeted step ran: `app heavy: pocket_pass_start`, ok, 1 step, 0 failed, 0 stalled (828 s), run by this review.
- The other reached lanes were not run by this review or by the author. The cut gate checks them.

### Requested before merge
1. **The Adaptive spiral round a part has no pin, and the PR says that it cannot have one.**
   - The PR body says: "Adaptive with Inside or Outside always falls back to Offset rings". The decision file says the HSM plan cannot start "in the air past the stock" (`docs/decisions/3822-pocket-ring-scope.md:23-35`). That is a fact of the dog bone fixture only.
   - With Outside and a stock outline, `adaptive_passes_from` calls the air plan (`pocket_hsm_start.rs:44-55`). `adaptive_ordered` returns `PocketStrategy::Adaptive` when the plan has no crossing and is in budget (`pocket_hsm.rs:69-70`).
   - Evidence: I ran a local probe (not pushed) on the fixture of `pocket_hsm_start_tests.rs` (sketch 96 mm square, stock 70 x 70, part 30 x 30, tool 10 mm), with `around_part: true` and Outside. The notes say "adaptive: stock ring cut from the air in 7 spiral and 2 open fronts", with no fallback note. This is an Adaptive spiral round a part.
   - The code keeps that path correct by construction (see above), but no test proves it. If a later change adds `Adaptive` to `ring_links::rings`, no pin fails.
   - Fix: add a pin on that fixture (or a similar one where the air plan succeeds), with `around_part: true` and Outside. Assert that there is no fallback note, and that the move digest equals main before #3818, as the Zigzag pin does. Use at least Retract and KeepDown. Then correct the Adaptive paragraph of the decision file and of the PR body: the real spiral keeps its links by the predicate (pinned), and the fallback rings take the ring law (pinned).
   - Class: a scope claim that was proved on one fixture only. One rule that closes the class: each strategy that `ring_links::rings` decides has its own pin. Ring strategies are pinned by the ring law. Other strategies (Zigzag, Adaptive spiral) are pinned equal to main before #3818.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- Inside round a part always falls back: the part is a hole of the area, so `pocket_hsm_start.rs:56-58` takes the rings. That part of the argument is correct.
- The `link:` note still says "instead of the keep-down ... link" for a Clearance or Retract pass link (`links.rs`). This is the same wording note as in the review of #3818. Consider a neutral word.
- Process: the body has `Changelog:` and ends with `Fixes #3822`. The commit subject is conventional. No process file and no snapshot PNG changes. `ring_links.rs` is 334 lines.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 325187e62e6b40c03c8258f9133002405dae1871 -->
<!-- review-cost: effort max, no escalation -->

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

The new predicate `ring_links::rings` gates `ring_links::for_side` at both
callers. Both callers read the strategy of the passes that are posted. A
strategy that loses the ring law does not lose a safety property: its link
is still proved against the certified cutter-centre area (which excludes the
part) and against a crossing of a planned cut, or it lifts with a named
reason.

## What looks good

- The gate is at `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs:353` and
  `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_avoid.rs:256`. A grep finds no other
  caller of `for_side`.
- Both callers pass the posted strategy. `pocket.rs` passes the `strategy`
  that the Adaptive fallback returns (`pocket.rs:312-318`). `pocket_avoid.rs`
  passes the `actual` strategy of the level (`plan_avoid_level`).
- The non-ring strategies (Zigzag, the Adaptive spiral) use the pre-#3818
  link law. `link_proof` (`ladder_links.rs:253`) refuses a chord that leaves
  the certified area. That area is the cutter-centre region less the part and
  the keep-out, so a chord cannot cross the part. If the proof fails, the
  link lifts.
- A failed ring link with `Link::Clearance` lifts to `m.clearance_z`
  (`ladder_links.rs:180`). Retract and KeepDown lift to `m.hop_z`, the
  retract plane (`min(retract, clearance)`). The tally names the plane
  (`links.rs:163-178`), and the default retract text does not change.
- No `unwrap`, `expect`, `panic!` or unchecked index math in the added
  source. No new dependency. No snapshot PNG change. No process file change.
- The decision record `docs/decisions/3822-pocket-ring-scope.md` follows
  `docs/decisions/README.md`.

## Results (local worktree, trial merge with origin/main)

The trial merge of `325187e62` with `origin/main` (`a6cd476fd`) is clean.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test pass_start_levels` | 18 passed, 0 failed (5 new pins) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib -- machining2d` | 277 passed, 0 failed, 22 ignored |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test offset_pass_start` | 6 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps, 0 failed: light build 2 s, `motion light: lib` 10 s, `motion light: adaptive_troch_island` 19 s, `motion light: adaptive_troch_neck` 13 s, `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel` 8 s, `app light: pocket_pass_start` 11 s |

## Targeted heavy step (P1)

`cargo xtask gate heavy --only "app heavy: offset_pass_start"` - 1 step,
ok in 60 s: 5 passed, 0 failed. The five ignored tests are
`fig8_outside_offset_starts_each_level_at_the_stock_edge`,
`fig8_outside_offset_cuts_no_move_at_full_width`,
`fig8_inside_offset_names_each_full_width_cut`,
`fig8_start_sides_have_no_crossing` (#3744), and
`lifts::fig8_start_sides_lift_only_with_a_named_reason`. The no-crossing
test is the app-level safety pin for both start sides. The PR body names
`app heavy: pocket_pass_start` (874 s). This review ran `offset_pass_start`
on the same head.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes

- The `ring_links.rs` module doc still describes the law for "2D Offset
  Pass starts at Inside, Outside and Auto" and does not name the new
  strategy gate. A one-line update would help a reader. This is not a
  blocker.
- `Fixes #3822` is true: the PR pins the 2D Pocket Outside rings (the
  issue's second option) and the Clearance lift choice, as the issue asks.
  The issues named in the prose (#3818, #3823, #3747, #3744, #3752) are not
  closed by this PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 20972341cedd3efdca19562bbd4a590075a2e015 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Delta re-review from 325187e62 to 20972341c. The finding of the last review is fixed.

### What looks good
- The new pin `adaptive_spiral_round_a_part_outside_equals_main_before_3818` compares with a real recording. I ran the same fixture (the `pocket_hsm_start_tests` square, Outside, stock 70 x 70, `around_part: true`) on `b2ff0ef1b`, the first parent of the #3818 merge `7f4915a6d`. The result there is 5687 moves, no fallback, digest `13996707157284497335`. That is the constant in the pin.
- The pin catches the predicate. With a local mutation (not committed, reverted) of `ring_links::for_side` to `if !side.around_part {`, the pin fails (`left: 10937783892351394388`, `right: 13996707157284497335`). `zigzag_rows_keep_their_links_round_a_part` fails too.
- The corrected text in the PR body and in `docs/decisions/3822-pocket-ring-scope.md` is accurate. On `b2ff0ef1b` the same square with Inside falls back to Offset rings ("Offset rings cut this pocket" note), and with Outside the spiral runs.
- The merge `b4ced8ac1` is plain: `git show --remerge-diff` is empty. In `pocket.rs` the merged tree keeps the `air` room of #3823 and the new `strategy` argument of `for_side`. In `pocket_avoid.rs` it keeps `.with_air(...)` and the `actual` argument. No logic is lost.
- No other change since 325187e62: only the merge and the pin commit (`pocket_outside.rs`, the decision file).
- The `(Some(Err(why)), Link::Clearance)` arm in `ladder_links::pass_link` is unchanged, and the body names the overlap with #3824.

### Results merged with main (locally, `origin/main` 8bd377a82, trial merge clean)
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test pass_start_levels` | 19 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test pocket_pass_start` (debug) | 5 passed, 2 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| Mutation: predicate removed | the new pin and the Zigzag pin red, as expected |

### Heavy lanes
- `app heavy: pocket_pass_start`: ok (204 s), run by this review on the trial merge. The merge with #3823 changed `pocket.rs`, which this lane reaches. The author's run in the body was on the first head.
- Other reached lanes were not run, by the standing order for targeted heavy steps. The cut gate runs them.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
- The Changelog line does not name Adaptive. That is correct: #3818 is in no tag yet, so the Adaptive output equals the last release.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
